Once upon a time, there was a brave little girl named Mia. She was always scared of the dark. One day, she was walking in the woods when she saw a little scared bunny. She was scared and didn't know what to do.

Mia's mom came in and said, "Don't worry, Mia. I will give you a new lantern to keep you safe." Mia was so happy and she ran to the door.

Mia's mom said, "Let's go and see what's inside. It's so dark and scary." Mia was so excited. She ran to the door and opened it. Inside, she found a bright light inside.

Mia was so happy and she thanked her mom. She said, "I'm glad you like it. I'm glad you like it."

Mia smiled and said, "I'm glad you like it. I'm glad you like it."

Once upon a time there was a brave little girl named Mia. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she was playing with her lantern when her brother came in. He was so scared that he wouldn't let her.

Mia was brave and she wanted to share her lantern with him. She held the lantern up high and said, "I'm sorry, I didn't mean to make you scared. I just wanted to play with you."

Her brother was so happy and he said, "Thank you, Mia! You are so brave!"

Mia smiled and said, "It's okay, I'm just happy to share my lantern with you."

The two of them played together for a while, and Mia was so happy that she had shared her lantern with her brother.

The moral of the story is that it's important to share with others, even if it's scary.

The moral of the story is that it's important to share with others and be brave.
